candidate_sentence_map.S1: For the financial year ended June 30, 2025, SAF Tehnika Group’s performance improved substantially in profitability despite lower revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Consolidated revenue decreased by 4% to EUR 25.99 million from EUR 27.09 million, while the parent company’s revenue declined by 6% to EUR 21.92 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: The main pressure came from the Americas, where revenue fell by 14% to EUR 14.17 million, representing 55% of Group revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Management attributed the decline largely to the timing of large projects, customer caution over investment decisions, and uncertainty surrounding tariff changes.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: European revenue increased by 17% to EUR 10.0 million, partly offsetting the decline, while revenue in Asia, Africa, and the Middle East decreased by 5% to EUR 1.8 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Profitability strengthened as production costs fell more sharply than revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Consolidated cost of goods sold declined to EUR 16.49 million from EUR 19.56 million, raising gross profit to EUR 9.50 million from EUR 7.53 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The operating loss narrowed to EUR 1.29 million from EUR 3.22 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Although administrative expenses increased to EUR 3.36 million, lower sales and marketing expenses and reduced production costs supported the improvement.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The Group reported a net loss of EUR 643 thousand, compared with a loss of EUR 2.37 million in the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Loss per share improved to EUR 0.216 from EUR 0.798.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The parent company’s net loss decreased to EUR 552 thousand from EUR 1.34 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The Group continued investing in product development and its microwave transmission, Spectrum Compact, and Aranet IoT product lines.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Research and development costs reached EUR 3.43 million, and product development projects received EUR 570 thousand of co-financing.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: The Group also established a Canadian branch to reduce potential supply-chain and customs risks.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: US tariffs on microwave equipment imported from the European Union were unchanged, while Aranet products were subject to a 15% tariff.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Management reported that market conditions were stabilizing, although it remained cautious about future sales and financial results.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Cash generation was a major positive development.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Net operating cash flow increased to EUR 3.87 million from EUR 1.71 million, and year-end cash rose to EUR 4.81 million from EUR 2.21 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: The Group invested EUR 812 thousand in IT infrastructure, production and research equipment, software, licenses, certification, and premises renovation.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Inventory increased to EUR 14.0 million, but the slow-moving inventory provision declined by EUR 1.24 million to EUR 3.86 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: Total liabilities increased to EUR 10.33 million, mainly reflecting higher customer advances and contract liabilities, while equity decreased to EUR 15.76 million because of the annual loss.
candidate_sentence_map.S23: The EUR 4.95 million credit line remained unused.
candidate_sentence_map.S25: The auditors issued an unmodified opinion, stating that the financial statements presented a true and fair view and complied with applicable IFRS requirements.
